docstring:
"""
Summary: 
Sets process attributes for a given task in the AppArmor security framework.

Parameters: 
task (struct task_struct *): The task for which the attributes are being set.
name (char *): The name of the attribute to set.
value (void *): The value to assign to the attribute.
size (size_t): The size of the value being set.

Returns: 
int: Returns the size of the value if successful, or an error code indicating the failure reason.

Logic: 
The function first checks if the size is zero or if the current task is not the one being modified, returning appropriate error codes. It ensures the value is null-terminated and processes the command extracted from the value. Depending on the attribute name and command, it calls specific functions to change the process's security attributes. If an error occurs, it logs an audit message and returns an error code.
"""
guard_description: Allocation and null-termination of a new buffer when the input is not null-terminated
rationale: Implementation A allocates a new buffer and null-terminates it if the input is not null-terminated, while B checks if the size is PAGE_SIZE and returns an error, otherwise it null-terminates in-place. B lacks the explicit allocation and null-termination of a new buffer when the input is not null-terminated, which A performs. This could lead to buffer overflow if the input is not null-terminated and size exceeds the allocated buffer size.
